name: Submerged Shard
source: Pathfinder Society Scenario #1-12: The Burden of Envy
description: An immense, jagged piece of clear crystal 10 feet square and forty feet high juts up from the seafloor
disable: DC 13 Survival check (trained) to blunt the crystal's edges without getting cut
reset: The hazard still damages any creature or object that enters its space, but the surface doesn't become hidden again until it settles over the course of 1 minute.

offensiveAbilities.name: Shard
offensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger A creature or object moves into the shard's space.

Effect The triggering creature takes 2d6+5 piercing damage (DC 17 basic Reflex save).
